reply:
That’s the loose end, then — “sometime Thursday afternoon” can land right on top of the review, and no time means you can’t plan around it, only react.

Two things that might tighten it without much cost:

- Text him midday for an ETA, or ask him to ring you 20 minutes out. Then you’re not camping on the phone, you’re just waiting for a known signal.
- Tell the juniors to park any end-of-review questions if you’re out, so the Q&A doesn’t evaporate while you’re downstairs with a bucket.

If he won’t give even that, the announcement still does its job — you step out when he calls. But I’d try to get one small commitment out of him first. Is he the type who’d text you, or is that a dead end?
